newsitem.title: SPAIN: FCC sees gross 1997 profit at 29.0 bln ptas.
newsitem.headline: FCC sees gross 1997 profit at 29.0 bln ptas.

text.p: Spanish construction group Fomento de Construcciones y Contratas (FCC) expects 1997 pretax profit of more than 29.0 billion pesetas versus 28.3 billion in 1996, chairman Guillermo Visedo told journalists on Wednesday.
Visedo added to expect turnover at 450 billion pesetas versus 429 billion in 1996.
"We expect to surpass 29 billion pesetas (in pre-tax profit)," he told reporters.

Visedo added that the alliance with Dragados y Construcciones to compete in the foreign markets through two joint ventures -- Dragados FCC Internacional de Construcciones SA and FCC Dragados Internacional de Servicios SA -- is doing fine.

They intend to double soon the capital of the two firms to 20 billion pesetas, and he added that these two have a leading position in the industry -- first in terms of profitability and fifth in turnover, which stands at 845 billion pesetas.
Visedo said the joint ventures were working on proposals for a motorway in Israel for 110 billion pesetas and another in Canada for 120 billion.
